`photo.jpg` and `photo.png` are 384 × 256 crops of NASA’s Eileen Collins photograph, distributed as [scikit-image’s astronaut sample](https://github.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/blob/v0.25.2/skimage/data/astronaut.png). The [dataset attribution](https://github.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/blob/v0.25.2/skimage/data/_fetchers.py#L382) identifies it as public domain. The icons and transparent UI sample were drawn for these tests.
